notes: The doubled 'ish 'ish is split: the lexical noun (with the supplied existential frame) on the first token, the distributive What ... soever on the second. The reverse assignment is defensible and is named in the unit's note.

there be is the construction's supplied existential frame in a verbless casuistic protasis, so it is not added (rule 20); the competing reading puts it on the min of mi-beth yisra'el as a prepositional predicate under rule 49.
The it of the second killeth answers to no object morpheme and is added under rule 44.
michuts fuses as without under rule 30, leaving the following le unrepresented under rule 40.
